subjects.description: Tokyo Tower, a tall red-and-white painted steel lattice tower, seen from street level
subjects.appearance_details: International orange and white bands, dense steel lattice, observation deck high above the street
subjects.location: Right side of frame, from midground rising out of the top edge
subjects.relative_size: Very large, dominating the right half
subjects.action: None; grows slightly larger as the camera advances
subjects.state_changes: Shifts gently right and grows as the camera moves forward.

subjects.description: A few pedestrians walking on the sidewalks
subjects.appearance_details: Ordinary office and travel clothing, small and indistinct at distance
subjects.location: Sidewalks in the midground and background

background_setting: A clean urban street in central Tokyo near Tokyo Tower. Concrete and glass mid-rise office buildings line the left side, the street continues straight ahead to a distant intersection with high-rise towers on the skyline. Asphalt road with white lane markings and paved sidewalks.

lighting.shadows: Crisp building shadows across the street and sidewalk
lighting.illumination_effect: Bright natural daylight with realistic reflections on glass facades

aesthetics.composition: One-point perspective down the street with Tokyo Tower framing the right side
aesthetics.color_scheme: Clear blue sky, neutral gray concrete and asphalt, red and white of the tower

cinematography.camera_motion: Slow steady forward walking shot at eye level
cinematography.framing: Wide shot of the street with the tower on the right
cinematography.camera_angle: Eye-level, about 1.6 meters above the ground, tilted slightly upward

context: First-person preview of walking toward Tokyo Tower before a trip

actions.description: Camera walks steadily forward along the street; Tokyo Tower occupies the right side, office buildings on the left.
Camera continues forward; the tower grows slightly and the street ahead opens toward the intersection.

segments.description: A continuous eye-level forward walk along a sunny Tokyo street toward Tokyo Tower.

temporal_caption: The camera walks slowly forward at eye level along a quiet, sunlit street in central Tokyo. Tokyo Tower rises on the right in red and white steel lattice, while concrete and glass office buildings line the left. The street runs straight ahead to a distant intersection with high-rise towers. A few pedestrians walk along the sidewalks. The layout of buildings, roads and the tower stays exactly as given; no structures are added or removed.
audio_description: Quiet city ambience, distant traffic, footsteps; no dialogue or music.
